timezoneNote: Dates are U.S. Eastern/Central unless stated; the annual meeting is 3:00 p.m. CT = 22:00 CET. “Tentative” means Tesla has not confirmed the date.

events.title: Tesla launches in Argentina
events.detail: Tesla Latin America says Tesla arrives in Argentina on 20 November; @Tesla confirmed “launching in Argentina later this month”.

events.title: Cybercab service in Dallas
events.detail: Ashok Elluswamy said on the Q3 call (21 Oct) that Cybercab would launch in Dallas “next month”, the first city outside Austin. Dallas already has unsupervised Model Y Robotaxi service.

events.title: 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders
events.detail: Three items: re-elect Elon Musk, Robyn Denholm and JB Straubel; advisory say-on-pay vote; ratify PwC. No shareholder proposals on the ballot. Record date 13 Oct 2026.

events.title: Possible SpaceX–Tesla merger announcement
events.detail: Bloomberg (12 Nov) reports talks are progressing and an announcement could come as soon as December, or slip into early 2027. Both boards have special committees of independent directors; no terms, valuation or exchange ratio have been agreed. A deal would need a Tesla shareholder vote.

events.title: First Cybercabs to customers; 400 MW of SI training compute
events.detail: Lars Moravy: “we’re trying to get Cybercabs to customers by the end of this year.” Tesla also plans to reach 400 MW of SI training compute by year-end (Cortex 1 + 2 were >225 MW at 30 Sep).
events.source: Q3 2026 call via TeslaNorth; Q3 2026 Update

events.title: Q4 2026 production, deliveries & deployments
events.detail: Date not yet announced. 2026 deliveries through Q3 were 1,324,681. Visible Alpha’s FY2026 consensus of about 1.77 million (per Reuters, 21 Oct) implies roughly 445,000 in Q4.
events.source: Tesla Q3 P&D; Reuters / Visible Alpha

events.title: Q4 & FY2026 results
events.detail: Not confirmed by Tesla; 27 Jan is the commonly cited estimate. Street FY2026: revenue ~$107.9B, non-GAAP EPS ~$1.72 (S&P Global, 44 analysts).

events.title: Optimus with AI5
events.detail: Musk said AI5 should go into Optimus around April 2027 “if things go according to plan”, and that the Fremont line needs at least a year to reach ~20,000 units a week.
events.source: Q3 2026 call via TeslaNorth / Yahoo Finance

events.title: First customer cars join the Robotaxi network (FSD V15)
events.detail: Elluswamy: “somewhere around Q2 next year is when we can turn on some of the first customer vehicles to be part of the robotaxi fleet.”

events.title: Cybertruck production ends at Giga Texas
events.detail: Musk first said mid-2027 (6 Nov), then extended production “through the end of summer 2027” (11 Nov) to work through the backlog; the line is then converted for Cybercab.

events.title: Musk’s 2018-award restricted shares vest
events.detail: About 304.0M options were exercised in June 2026 (≈17.5M shares withheld for the exercise price); the resulting restricted shares vest on 19 Jan 2028 if Musk stays in service, then carry a five-year holding period.

risks.title: Merger terms and conflicts
risks.detail: Musk holds about 20% of Tesla and roughly 82% of SpaceX voting power. The exchange ratio is undecided, and a change in control can accelerate both of his pay packages; independent special committees are negotiating.

risks.title: Valuation
risks.detail: About 478× trailing GAAP EPS (CNBC) and ~230× Street FY2026 non-GAAP EPS. The average Street target ($412) is only ~4% above the 12 Nov close, and 22 of 44 analysts rate it Hold.

risks.title: Core auto economics
risks.detail: Q3 deliveries fell 2% year on year, average selling prices fell again, and regulatory-credit revenue dropped to $113M from $417M. Battery supply is the stated limit on volume.

risks.title: Capex and free cash flow
risks.detail: Tesla guides ~$20B of capex for 2026, rising after that (Musk: “tens of billions in ’28”). Street FY2026 free cash flow is about −$4.6B, but $45.4B of cash and $30B of undrawn credit lines cushion it.

risks.title: Autonomy and regulation
risks.detail: FSD is still supervised in customer cars, and unsupervised use is targeted for ~Q2 2027. NHTSA sent a 21-question special order on Cybercab’s self-certification, and a securities class action concerns Autopilot/FSD/Robotaxi statements.

risks.title: Energy, tariffs and politics
risks.detail: Q3 energy revenue fell 16% partly due to tariff-related refunds, and deployments of 13.7 GWh missed the ~15.9 GWh estimate. Democrats now control Congress and have pledged to scrutinise Musk’s companies.
